articles.title: Ethereum Price Prediction as ETH ETF Inflows Hit 2-Week High Despite Goldman Sachs Rate Hike Warning
articles.description: Ethereum price rose to an 8-month high above $2,600 as inflows to ETH ETFs topped $216M despite surging odds that the Fed will hike rates.

articles.title: NFT sales rise 6.8% to $46.8M as Bitcoin trades surge
articles.description: NFT sales rose 6.8% to $46.78 million in seven days, with Ethereum leading and large Bitcoin BRC-20 trades lifting volume.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $462.7M as Ethereum funds gain $196.9M
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs lost $462.7 million in the Sept. 8–11 trading week, while Ethereum and Solana funds gained and Hyperliquid ETFs posted outflows.
